title: Report a transient managed custody journal state as busy rather than as a recovery instruction
outcome: Report a transient managed custody journal state as busy rather than as a recovery instruction
acceptance: A reader of the managed custody journal that runs between a managed re-audit's head acknowledgement and journal activation receives a retryable busy error, not 'run a custody audit' or 'journal is missing'
When the caller already holds the audit reservation, journal::observe reports the real pending-journal error (noncanonical, divergent or I/O) instead of 'busy; retry'
